description: Your Uber Eats order history as a local database — spend, favourites, and search the app cannot answer.
auth_description: Uber Eats consumer endpoints are cookie-session only. Sign in at ubereats.com in Chrome, then run auth login --chrome. There is no public buyer OAuth.

novel_features.name: Local order-history mirror
novel_features.description: Walk every page of getPastOrdersV1 and mirror orders plus line items into SQLite, incrementally by default.

novel_features.name: Order history queries
novel_features.description: List synced orders newest-first with date bounds, or fetch one order with its line items by id.

novel_features.name: Spend by month or year
novel_features.description: Sum order totals into monthly or yearly buckets from the local mirror.

novel_features.name: Most-ordered items
novel_features.description: Rank line items by quantity across every synced order, with order counts and spend.

novel_features.name: Most-ordered restaurants
novel_features.description: Rank restaurants by order count and total spend.

novel_features.name: Offline text search
novel_features.description: Case-insensitive search across restaurant names and item titles in the local mirror.
